items.impact: Normal reading runs could not safely mark a new or modified paper complete when the large generated identity index had to be rewritten.
items.resolution: Workflow v7 introduced connector-safe identity deltas; workflow v8 retains them.

items.impact: Connector-only runs could save a paper and identity delta but could not safely rewrite the large plan and queue as one atomic bundle, leaving FlashMoE unreconciled.
attempted_fixes: Saved and reverified the FlashMoE core artifact and identity delta.
Restored a tentative queue-only change instead of publishing inconsistent state.
items.resolution: Workflow v8 makes the plan a selection snapshot and records per-paper completion in small progress-delta files. Plan/queue full rewrites are no longer required for normal completion. FlashMoE is reconciled by a recovery delta backed by its existing artifacts and run records.
